criteria.description: The drift report was written within the chore's period: a run that did not look cannot pass (GHI #935, #1369)
Every Python dependency, build pin, the .python-version interpreter, the uv binary, each pre-commit hook rev and each Actions pin is at upstream latest, or held by an open GHI (GHI #1369)
uv.lock agrees with pyproject.toml after the upgrade
The Python version is declared once and the Astral toolchain config holds
Project lint baseline holds on the upgraded toolchain (uses gzkit's configured exclusions)
Project typecheck baseline holds on the upgraded toolchain (uses gzkit's configured exclusions)
